items.name: Dario Picardi
items.bio: Italian-born international executive, entrepreneur and investor. After more than fifteen years leading brands and commercial organizations across Europe, the Americas, the Middle East and Asia, he founded BIZ & STYLE in Miami in 2017 — a business ecosystem connecting commerce, advisory, investment, real estate and luxury.
